properties.description: add_actor is new; add_capability takes tier and the two flow-endpoint flags; add_component and add_flow take tier; add_constraint takes concern and priority; add_requirement takes concern; add_interface takes spec; add_project takes decomposition_levels, which hierarchy.rs reads on every level check and nothing could write; link_artifact takes content_ref and note_kind onto the provenance fragment it mints. Omitting any of them changes nothing. The reachability report reads 0 HOLE, and the 28 properties still unreachable are so on purpose: 15 written by an operation, where a caller parameter would let somebody forge a computed fact, and 13 carried by nothing at all.
properties.name: v0.54.0 — every declared hole in the vocabulary is closed
